verdict.rationale: Atlassian documents product sandboxes for Jira as isolated, replica-of-production environments for testing changes safely before production, and also offers free 90-day Forge demo development sites for testing apps. This is first-party, direct sandbox isolation (not merely a dry-run), but it is limited to Premium/Enterprise plans and has no documented detail on API or agent access to sandboxes. Missing for 10: sandbox availability on all plans, documentation that AI/agent and API tooling can target sandboxes, clarity on how production data is copied or isolated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A sandbox is an isolated environment where you can experiment and test changes safely before applying them in production. Every sandbox works like a replica of your production environment
Forge can provision a demo development site when you need an Atlassian site for developing and testing an app
